specs.value: Priming button on lid, flow-control/lock lever, 360° rotating connector, bottom-to-top flow through trays
Filter floss only; extra media recommended

prices.shop: Cá Cảnh Kim Giang (out of stock)

fits.fact: Sellers rate it for tanks about 90–150 cm long, roughly 200–400 L.
Marketed for both planted tanks and fish-only tanks.
Listed as usable in both freshwater and marine tanks.
For tanks under about 90 cm, the smaller RF-501 or RF-701 from the same range is the size match.
The 3-tray RF-1301 has the same pump as the 2-tray RF-1001 but holds more media and is rated for larger tanks.

usage.fact: Fix the intake and outlet hoses to the tank wall, then pump the priming button repeatedly until water fills the canister and comes out the outlet.
One shop suggests starting the siphon from the outlet hose instead of relying on the priming button.
Put the canister below the tank's water line and keep the tank full. Cut hoses to length, because extra tubing tangles and reduces flow.
Tighten every fitting before you plug it in, and never run the pump dry.
According to the seller, it restarts by itself after a power cut without needing to be primed again.
Put coarse media at the bottom, finer media above it, and a thin layer of floss on top. Don't pack the media tightly, because that creates channels water can bypass through.
The trays are different sizes, so each one must go back in its original position.
For maintenance, clean the trays and impeller when the filter has gone a long time without service or debris is blocking the impeller. If air gets in, replace the hose gasket.
When cleaning, take care with the plastic lock, which can crack. Don't drop the ceramic impeller shaft, and leave it in place unless it is stuck.
The flow lock lever makes it easier to disconnect the hoses for cleaning.

issues.fact: A seller warns that bio balls in the trays make noise and let debris into the trays' flow channels.
The same seller says the ceramic media that comes with the unit has little biological capacity and should be replaced.
The plastic lock clip can crack if handled roughly during disassembly.
If the hose gaskets don't seal, air can get into the lines, so the connections need to stay airtight.
Sold as a 'new generation' (thế hệ mới) version, but no source explains how it differs from the earlier one.
Listed dimensions don't agree: 22×22×47 cm, 22×22×42 cm and 26×26×47 cm all appear. Measure your cabinet before buying.
The shops' 'quiet' claims come with no measured noise figure. One listing also shows an obviously wrong weight of 8000 kg.

alternatives.why: It has the same 22 W, 1500 L/h pump with 2 trays instead of 3 and costs about 100,000 VND less. That makes it a cheaper choice for 80–120 cm tanks.

A common Chinese canister in a higher class: about 2000 L/h and 55 W, with a built-in 9 W UV lamp. It suits larger tanks or tanks prone to green water. Overseas users report mixed results on noise and leaks. I found no VND price on Vietnamese shop websites.
A premium German canister with a long track record for reliability, aimed at buyers who put quiet running and durability first. It costs much more than Atman.
